page.overview:
Who is Azathoth's aliases?

As one of the most prominent elements in the Cthulhu Mythos, the Outer God Azathoth has gone through many different aliases over the years. This page offers a guide to the various names of Azathoth, including the avatars employed by this eldritch abomination.
